sources.snippet: Brain Tumor Detection and Classification using Vision Transformers This repository contains an implementation of a Vision Transformer (ViT) model designed to classify brain tumor images into four categories (Meningioma, Pituitary, Glioma and No tumor). The model can be trained on any dataset of brain tumor MRI scans.
